0001-demo-auth.why: Every request is the demo's one human principal (demo@getkestrel.dev, via "demo"), so a spec that expects a 401 without a credential, a 400/403/404 that only comes after a refused sign-in, the dev or Access auth mode, or a named person or service token as who acted (whoami, a revision's author, an import's or a send's actor, an action log line, an MCP tool call, Resolve's audit note) gets the demo principal instead.
